description: This file defines a media playback service for an Android app, including a LifecycleService subclass (MusicService) and a Binder class (MusicServiceBinder) that manages media playback, notifications, and audio focus.

classes.name: MusicService
classes.description: An Android LifecycleService that manages media playback, notifications, and user interactions for music playback.

classes.name: MusicServiceBinder
classes.description: A Binder class that controls media playback, manages media session, notifications, and audio focus.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the MusicService and its binder.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles start commands and updates playback state based on intent action.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the binder for clients binding to the service.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the service is destroyed.

methods.name: initializePlayer
methods.description: Prepares the media player with an attachment and starts playback.

methods.name: startPlaying
methods.description: Starts media playback if audio focus is granted and media is prepared.

methods.name: stopPlaying
methods.description: Stops media playback and releases resources if specified.

methods.name: seekTo
methods.description: Seeks media to a specified position based on percentage.
